verses.text: عَلَى الْمُصْطَفَى مِنِّى صَلَاةٌ تَقِى الضَّيْرَا
verses.transcription: halal mustafaa minnii salaatun taqid dayraa

verses.text: جِهَاتِى كَمَا يُفْضِى إِلَى نَحْوِىَ الْخَيْرَا
verses.transcription: jihaatii kamaa yufdii ilaa nahwiyal khayraa

verses.text: عَلَى الْمُنْتَقَى مِنِّى سَلَامٌ مُّطَهِّرٌ
verses.transcription: halal muntaqaa minnii salaamun mutahhirun

verses.text: لِّكُلِّيَّتِى تَطْهِيرَ هَادٍ مَّحَا جَوْرَا
verses.transcription: likulliyyatii tat-hiira haadin mahaa jawraa

verses.text: صَلَاةٌ وَتَسْلِيمٌ مِّنَ اللَّهِ سَرْمَدًا
verses.transcription: salaatun wa tasliimun minal laahi sarmadan

verses.text: عَلَى مَنْ بِرَزَّقٍ يُصَفِّى لِىَ الْمَيْرَا
verses.transcription: halaa man birazzaqin yusaffii liyal mayraa

verses.text: عَلَى مَنْ بِهِ ى رَبُّ الْوَرَى أَنْشَأَ الْوَرَى
verses.transcription: halaa man bihii rabbul waraa ansa-al waraa

verses.text: صَلَاةٌ وَتَسْلِيمٌ يَدُو مَانِ لِى زَوْرَا
verses.transcription: salaatun wa taslimun yadduu maani lii zawraa

verses.text: مِنَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ أَبْغِى بِهِ الْبِرَّا
verses.transcription: minal laahi rabbil harshi abghii bihil birraa

verses.text: بِجَاهِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ مَنْ كَلْكَلِى سَرَّا
verses.transcription: bijaahi rasuulil laahi man kalkalii sarraa

verses.text: عَلَيْكَ صَلَاةُ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ سَلَامُهُ
verses.transcription: halayka salaatul laahi  summa salaamuhu

verses.text: دَوَامًا كَمَآ أَفْضَى إِلَى غَيْرِىَ الشَّرَّا
verses.transcription: dawaaman kamaa afdaa ilaa ghayriyash sharraa

verses.text: تَقَدُّ مَكَ الْبَادِى بَدَا لِى وَقَادَ لِى
verses.transcription: taqaddu makal baadii badaa lii wa qaada lii

verses.text: نَوَلًا عَجِيبًا أَحْسَرَ الْجَهْرَ وَالسِّرَّا
verses.transcription: nawalan hajiiban ahsaral jahra was sirraa

verses.text: مِنَ اللَّهِ رُمْ لِى كَوْنَهُ لِى بِفَضْلِهِ
verses.transcription: minal laahi rum lii kawnahu lii bifadlihi

verses.text: خَدِيمًا لَّكُمْ يَامَنْ كَفَانِى الْعِدَى طُرَّا
verses.transcription: khadiiman lakum yaa man kafaanil hidaa turraa

verses.text: عَلَيْكُمْ صَلَاةٌ مَّعْ سَلَامٍ مِّنَ الْعَلِى
verses.transcription: halaykum salaatun mah salaamin minal halii

verses.text: بِئَالٍ وَأَصْحَابٍ لَّكُمْ مَّنْ حَوَوْاْ بِرَّا
verses.transcription: bi-aalin wa as-haabin lakum man hawaw birraa

verses.text: عَلَيْكُمْ صَلَاةُ اللَّهِ مَا انْقَادَتِ الْمُنَى
verses.transcription: halaykum salaatul laahi man qaadatil munaa

verses.text: لِكُلِّى بِلَا مَكْرٍ وَمَا كَلْكَلِى سَرَّا
verses.transcription: likullii bilaa makrin wa maa kalkalii sarraa

bayts.text: عَلَى الْمُصْطَفَى مِنِّى صَلَاةٌ تَقِى الضَّيْرَا ۞ جِهَاتِى كَمَا يُفْضِى إِلَى نَحْوِىَ الْخَيْرَا

translations.it.karamati: Sull'Eletto (Muḥammad), da parte mia, una benedizione che preservi dal danno ogni mio lato, così come egli fa giungere verso di me il bene.
translations.en.karamati: Upon the Chosen One (Muḥammad), from me, a blessing that guards every side of me from harm, just as he makes good reach toward me.
translations.fr.karamati: Sur l'Élu (Muḥammad), de ma part, une bénédiction qui préserve du mal chacun de mes côtés, de même qu'il fait parvenir vers moi le bien.

bayts.text: عَلَى الْمُنْتَقَى مِنِّى سَلَامٌ مُّطَهِّرٌ ۞ لِّكُلِّيَّتِى تَطْهِيرَ هَادٍ مَّحَا جَوْرَا

translations.it.karamati: Sul Prescelto (Muḥammad), da parte mia, un saluto che purifichi tutto il mio essere, della purificazione di una guida che ha cancellato l'ingiustizia.
translations.en.karamati: Upon the Elect (Muḥammad), from me, a greeting of peace that purifies my whole being, with the purification of a guide who has erased injustice.
translations.fr.karamati: Sur le Préféré (Muḥammad), de ma part, un salut qui purifie tout mon être, de la purification d'un guide qui a effacé l'injustice.

bayts.text: صَلَاةٌ وَتَسْلِيمٌ مِّنَ اللَّهِ سَرْمَدًا ۞ عَلَى مَنْ بِرَزَّقٍ يُصَفِّى لِىَ الْمَيْرَا

translations.it.karamati: Benedizione e saluto da Allah, in eterno, su colui che, per mezzo di un Provveditore (Allah), rende puro per me il vettovagliamento.
translations.en.karamati: Blessing and peace from Allah, forever, upon him who, through a Provider (Allah), makes my provisions pure for me.
translations.fr.karamati: Bénédiction et salut d'Allah, éternellement, sur celui qui, par un Pourvoyeur (Allah), rend pures pour moi les provisions.

bayts.text: عَلَى مَنْ بِهِ ى رَبُّ الْوَرَى أَنْشَأَ الْوَرَى ۞ صَلَاةٌ وَتَسْلِيمٌ يَدُو مَانِ لِى زَوْرَا

translations.it.karamati: Su colui per mezzo del quale il Signore delle creature ha creato le creature, benedizione e saluto che perdurino, per me, come visita.
translations.en.karamati: Upon him through whom the Lord of creatures created the creatures, blessing and peace that endure, for me, as a visit.
translations.fr.karamati: Sur celui par qui le Seigneur des créatures a créé les créatures, bénédiction et salut qui durent, pour moi, comme une visite.

bayts.text: مِنَ اللَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَرْشِ أَبْغِى بِهِ الْبِرَّا ۞ بِجَاهِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ مَنْ كَلْكَلِى سَرَّا

translations.it.karamati: Da Allah, Signore del Trono, desidero per mezzo di lui la bontà, per il rango dell'Inviato di Allah, colui che ha rallegrato il mio petto.
translations.en.karamati: From Allah, Lord of the Throne, I seek through him goodness, by the rank of the Messenger of Allah, he who has gladdened my breast.
translations.fr.karamati: D'Allah, Seigneur du Trône, je désire par lui la bonté, par le rang de l'Envoyé d'Allah, celui qui a réjoui ma poitrine.

bayts.text: عَلَيْكَ صَلَاةُ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ سَلَامُهُ ۞ دَوَامًا كَمَآ أَفْضَى إِلَى غَيْرِىَ الشَّرَّا

translations.it.karamati: Su di te la benedizione di Allah, poi il Suo saluto, perennemente, così come (Egli) ha fatto giungere ad altri che me il male.
translations.en.karamati: Upon you be the blessing of Allah, then His peace, perpetually, just as (He) has made evil reach others than me.
translations.fr.karamati: Sur toi la bénédiction d'Allah, puis Son salut, perpétuellement, de même qu'(Il) a fait parvenir à d'autres que moi le mal.

bayts.text: تَقَدُّ مَكَ الْبَادِى بَدَا لِى وَقَادَ لِى ۞ نَوَلًا عَجِيبًا أَحْسَرَ الْجَهْرَ وَالسِّرَّا

translations.it.karamati: La tua precedenza manifesta mi è apparsa e mi ha condotto un dono mirabile, che ha superato ogni misura del palese e del segreto.
translations.en.karamati: Your manifest precedence has appeared to me and led to me a wondrous gift, which has surpassed every measure of the open and the secret.
translations.fr.karamati: Ta préséance manifeste m'est apparue et m'a conduit un don merveilleux, qui a dépassé toute mesure de l'apparent et du secret.

bayts.text: مِنَ اللَّهِ رُمْ لِى كَوْنَهُ لِى بِفَضْلِهِ ۞ خَدِيمًا لَّكُمْ يَامَنْ كَفَانِى الْعِدَى طُرَّا

translations.it.karamati: Da Allah chiedi per me che Egli, per Sua grazia, faccia di me un servitore per voi, o tu che mi hai preservato dai nemici, tutti quanti.
translations.en.karamati: From Allah seek for me that He, by His grace, make me a servant for you, O you who have spared me from the enemies, every one of them.
translations.fr.karamati: D'Allah demande pour moi qu'Il fasse de moi, par Sa grâce, un serviteur pour vous, ô toi qui m'as préservé des ennemis, tous sans exception.

bayts.text: عَلَيْكُمْ صَلَاةٌ مَّعْ سَلَامٍ مِّنَ الْعَلِى ۞ بِئَالٍ وَأَصْحَابٍ لَّكُمْ مَّنْ حَوَوْاْ بِرَّا

translations.it.karamati: Su di voi una benedizione con un saluto dall'Altissimo (Al-ʿAlī), con la vostra Famiglia e i vostri Compagni, coloro che hanno racchiuso la bontà.
translations.en.karamati: Upon you a blessing with peace from the Most High (Al-ʿAlī), with your Family and your Companions, those who have gathered goodness.
translations.fr.karamati: Sur vous une bénédiction avec un salut du Très-Haut (Al-ʿAlī), avec votre Famille et vos Compagnons, ceux qui ont renfermé la bonté.

bayts.text: عَلَيْكُمْ صَلَاةُ اللَّهِ مَا انْقَادَتِ الْمُنَى ۞ لِكُلِّى بِلَا مَكْرٍ وَمَا كَلْكَلِى سَرَّا

translations.it.karamati: Su di voi la benedizione di Allah, finché le aspirazioni si sottomettano a tutto il mio essere senza inganno, e finché (Egli) rallegri il mio petto.
translations.en.karamati: Upon you be the blessing of Allah, as long as aspirations yield to my whole being without guile, and as long as (He) gladdens my breast.
translations.fr.karamati: Sur vous la bénédiction d'Allah, tant que les aspirations se soumettent à tout mon être sans ruse, et tant qu'(Il) réjouit ma poitrine.
